name: Vikram (Chandrayaan-2)
tagline: Lander of India's Chandrayaan-2; it crashed in 2019, but the orbiter kept working
description: Vikram was the lander of India's Chandrayaan-2 mission, built by ISRO. It crashed during its landing attempt in September 2019, but the Chandrayaan-2 orbiter kept working in lunar orbit.
best_known_for: Lander of India's Chandrayaan-2; it crashed in 2019, but the orbiter kept working
